description: The column a page's content sits in, at the page width with a gutter either side, centred. Both lengths are roles, so a style plugin narrows or widens every page at once. The gutter is a ceiling rather than a fixed inset. Below the page width the band stands off by the same share of the space it has. A phone then keeps a content column instead of spending two fifths of the screen on margin. The band carries no block air; the space above and below is yours, on the spacing scale.
